title: New Milford Historical Society Museum

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: There are no special exhibits currently on view at the Society. During the winter month especially, we try to take some time for house-keeping chores, like entering more data into our system Plus, of course, we need time to create our next big thing! You can be sure that there are a number of special exhibits planned or being installed, and we hope you will check back to see them. Of course, we would be remiss in our duty if we didn't ask that you contribute to the Museum's long-term health! We have two terrific ways that you can help, either by making a donation, or by becoming a member. Can we rely on you, now? We have our collection indexed and inventoried electronically.
